art_direction: Established lateral minimal dark-fantasy pixel art; approved sources and spec; no new lore, clothing exposure or covered/horse wagon.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent game sprite, NOT a sheet or lineup. One full-body plagued elf named aelira, reference identity number 1 from left in the M-03 lineup, olive-green forager clothing. Genuinely lying on the ground on their side or back with anatomically coherent legs and arms, exhausted but alive, no gore. Preserve white hair, pointed ears and personal clothing from identity reference, fully opaque trousers and boots. Simple large pixel clusters, short palette, no microtexture, no background or text. Intended common 64x64 logical cell, reclining body crown-to-heel length 40 logical pixels, same anatomical body scale as Lolth, no foreshortening; limbs may be lightly bent but measurable. Ground contact aligned, entire body within cell with transparent gutter. No held weapon, role power or standing figure rotated sideways.
assets.measurement_note: Crown-to-heel anatomical length, not vertical recumbent bbox; measurable landmarks required before acceptance.
